title: Barkpark CLI capabilities manifest
description: THE single frozen superset schema for the manifest emitted by GET /v1/capabilities. Assembled at request time, auth-aware, additive-evolution only. Every consumer surface (CLI, MCP, SDK, batch, testing) builds its command tree, tool list, and completion ONLY from this document — nothing downstream hardcodes a noun, verb, flag, or route. Structural objects are strict (additionalProperties:false) so a typo or stray field fails fast; growth axes (noun names, verb names, command ids, plugin names) stay UNCONSTRAINED so a future plugin adds commands with zero schema change.

$comment.description: OPTIONAL free-text annotation on a manifest instance (e.g. a fixture documenting its role). Allowed ONLY at the document root — structural sub-objects stay strict. Ignored by consumers; carries no contract meaning.

manifest_version.description: Manifest contract version. Additive evolution only; bump on a breaking change. Pinned to "1" for the M0 freeze.

server.description: Identity of the responding Barkpark instance.

base_url.description: Absolute base URL the CLI prepends to every command's http.path_template.

api_version.description: OPTIONAL (additive). The API contract version this manifest describes — distinct from the server release `version`. Lets a consumer assert which contract surface it is talking to without inferring from the release string.

min_cli.description: OPTIONAL (additive). Minimum CLI semver required to drive this server. A CLI older than this MUST abort with a clear upgrade message rather than silently mis-driving a newer contract.

build.description: Server build identity (optional; instance-version space vA.B.C.D). Absent on servers older than the self-update feature.

auth_tier.description: The CALLER's projected tier — the resolved tier of THIS request's token. Echoes the auth context so the CLI can render `whoami` without a dedicated endpoint (the manifest's caller-tier echo + GET /v1/meta cover whoami's needs; see plan open decision #6). DISTINCT from each command's required auth_tier.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when this manifest was assembled.

etag.description: Content-addressed ETag. Varies by auth tier (an admin manifest and a public manifest have different etags) — drives 304 Not Modified and the on-disk cache keyed by token tier.

nouns.description: All nouns the caller may see, projected through the SAME default-deny allow-list as commands (existence-hiding: an anonymous caller learns zero admin noun names). Noun `name` is intentionally a free string with NO enum — new plugins add nouns additively.

commands.description: Every command the caller may see — `<noun> <verb>` leaves of the CLI tree. Forward-compatible: unknown FUTURE commands validate as long as each one is structurally well-formed.

auth_tier.$comment: CODE FACT over handbook. The handbook (make_cli_handbook_paper.py §3) lists FOUR tiers — read, write, admin, ingest — and omits `none` and `scoped_admin`. The router (api/lib/barkpark_web/router.ex) proves SIX distinct auth pipelines: OptionalToken public reads => `none`/`read`, `:require_write` (RequireWritePermission) => `write`, `:require_admin` => `admin`, `:scoped_admin` (RequireWorkspaceRole, per-workspace role gate) => `scoped_admin`, `:ingest` (RequireIngestToken) => `ingest`. Per the contract spine's non-negotiable rule #2, `scoped_admin` MUST be distinct from `admin` (a global tier cannot express per-workspace role), and `none` is the existence-hiding floor an anonymous caller sees. This enum is one of the FEW closed enums in the schema because auth pipelines are fixed in code, not grown by plugins.

default_output.$comment: Handbook §4/§28 names `table | json | yaml` as the -o/--output values; the contract spine (cli_plan.md) adds `minimal` for the token-efficient agent receipt (rev + ids only). Folded both => 4 values. Closed enum: output renderers are CLI-internal, not plugin-grown.

http_method.$comment: Every method present in router.ex. Closed enum — HTTP verbs do not grow.

noun.description: A top-level resource in the CLI tree. Core nouns (doc, schema, media, search, workspace, task, webhook, rail, plugin) carry plugin:null; plugin-contributed nouns (bulldocs, onixedit, indx, frt) carry plugin:<slug>.

name.description: The noun token typed on the command line (e.g. "doc", "bulldocs"). NO enum — additive-only growth axis.

plugin.description: Owning plugin slug, or null for a core host noun. Optional; absence is equivalent to null (core).

command.description: One `<noun> <verb>` command = one API call. The CLI wires NO per-verb code; it builds the leaf entirely from these fields.

id.description: Stable, unique command identifier (e.g. "doc.get", "bulldocs.publish"). NO enum — additive-only growth axis.

noun.description: The noun this command hangs under; matches a nouns[].name. NO enum.

verb.description: The action token (e.g. "get", "ls", "publish"). NO enum — additive-only growth axis.

summary.description: One-line description of what the command does.

http.description: The single API call this command makes. Templates are FLAT (contract spine rule #4); the CLI prepends its own /w/:ws/p/:project prefix locally from resolved scope when scoped_prefix is set.

auth_tier.description: The tier REQUIRED to invoke this command. The CLI maps it to the credential it sends. NOTE: the CLI must NOT preflight-refuse a `scoped_admin` command — only the server knows the caller's per-workspace role (contract spine rule #2).

flags.description: Named flags for this command (command-local; global flags live in the CLI itself).

writes.description: True if this is a mutating verb (sends through a write/admin/ingest path).

batch.description: True if the command accepts a batch body ({ops:[…]} or mutations[]) for atomic multi-op application.

paginated.description: True if the command supports list pagination (--limit/--offset/--all). $comment: the contract spine (cli_plan.md line 44) modelled this as paginated:{strategy:offset|cursor|none}; the FROZEN superset uses a plain boolean per the prompt's field contract — strategy detail is deferred (CLI v1 uses offset pagination uniformly per handbook §4).

dry_run.description: True ONLY if the SERVER supports validate-only for this command. HONEST flag (contract spine rule #5): ships false on every command in v1 unless the batch team builds server-side validate-only; the CLI's --dry-run degrades to client-side request-printing when this is false.

default_output.description: What an agent/default-shape caller gets for this command (writes typically advertise "minimal"; reads "table").

scoped_prefix.description: Optional hint that this flat command has a scoped mirror — the CLI may prepend /w/:ws/p/:project locally. The scoped MIRROR ENDPOINT itself is deferred (contract spine rule #4); null/absent means flat-only.

source.description: OPTIONAL (additive). Provenance of the command — "core" for a host-built command, or "plugin:<slug>" (e.g. "plugin:bulldocs") for a plugin-contributed one. Free string, NOT in the required list, so existing manifests still validate.

since.description: OPTIONAL (additive). The manifest/api version in which this command first appeared — used for version gating so a CLI can tell when a command is too new for the server it is pointed at. Free string, NOT in the required list.

arg.description: A positional argument. Per the M0 freeze the arg shape is intentionally THIN (name/required/type/summary) — rich per-arg JSON Schema is deferred (plan open decision #1).

required.description: True if the argument must be supplied.

type.description: Scalar type hint (e.g. "string", "slug", "int"). Free string — NOT a closed enum, so plugins can introduce type names additively.
Flag value type hint (e.g. "string", "bool", "file"). Free string — not a closed enum.

default.description: Optional default value when the flag is omitted. Any JSON type; absent means no default.

repeatable.description: True if the flag may be supplied multiple times (e.g. --set k=v --set k2=v2). Optional; absence equals false.
